svg.text: Each box is a subworkflow, each row a step every sample goes through (top to bottom). Each line is a use case: it stops at the steps that run in it.
Always: compare the VCF of every technology with the truth technology
With alignments (BAM/CRAM): callable regions and read evidence
--known_variants, mode benchmark: external truth set (e.g. SEQC2)
